# Causes of the French Revolution

**Social Structure and Inequality.** France was divided into three estates: the clergy (First Estate), the nobility (Second Estate), and everyone else (Third Estate). The Third Estate comprised roughly 97% of the population—peasants, urban workers, merchants, lawyers, and professionals—yet it bore nearly all the tax burden while the First and Second Estates enjoyed vast exemptions. This rigid hierarchy produced deep resentment among those who labored without political voice or social mobility, creating a powder keg
